action: Read the edition metadata and exact two-clause opening in Quranpedia's cited Qurtubi witness, then compared the opening clause with KSU and live paired rows without assigning Quranpedia's edition to KSU.

source_anchors.work: Al-Qurtubi, al-Jamiʿ li-ahkam al-Qurʾan, Quranpedia full-Surah witness
source_anchors.finding: Quranpedia identifies the displayed edition as second edition, edited by Ahmad al-Barduni and Ibrahim Atfish, published by Dar al-Kutub al-Misriyyah, Cairo. Its opening explicitly gives two clauses: Makki according to Ibn Abbas/al-Kalbi/Muqatil; Medinan according to al-Hasan/Ikrima/Mujahid/Qatada.
KSU's visible opening matches the first Makki clause and does not display the separate Medinan clause there; the page supplies no cited print-edition metadata.

source_anchors.locator: Supabase rows 13239 Arabic and 38030 English, 108:1, source_url 671.
source_anchors.finding: Arabic row includes only the Makki three-name clause; English row puts Mujahid in that opening. Stored hashes remain d813e9174d86a6f60a76cb2d88d67a0c (Arabic) and a2ed72b9348cbf3c4fbcfff5e7567bb7 (English).

interpretation.supported: Within Quranpedia's identified edition, Mujahid belongs to a distinct Medinan-opinion clause and is not a replacement for Muqatil in the Makki clause.
interpretation.not_established: The KSU electronic witness is not proven to use the same print edition solely because its opening text matches; no KSU print-edition mapping was found.
interpretation.change_guard: The proposed English correction remains narrow. Do not append the separate Medinan clause to the stored Arabic or English as part of this fix.
interpretation.source_identifier_guard: Legacy source value 671 is not converted to a URL, page, volume, or edition identifier.

unresolved: Independent review remains pending; the correction is not approved.
No clause absent from live Arabic may be silently imported.
